        *,
        row_number() over (
            partition by customer_id
            order by updated_at desc, created_at desc
        ) as rn
    from ML_PROJ.RAW_VALIDATED_VALIDATED.customers_validated

),

    select *
    from ranked
    where rn = 1

),

    select

        coalesce(
            try_to_date(trim(date_of_birth), 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
            try_to_date(trim(date_of_birth), 'DD/MM/YYYY'),

        annual_income_band,

        relationship_manager_id,

 as amount_inr,

with source as (

    select *
    from ML_PROJ.RAW_VALIDATED_INTERMEDIATE.int_customer_monthly_balance

)

select
    customer_id,

    -- Average balance across all available months
    avg(average_balance_in_month) as avg_monthly_balance,

    -- Volatility = stddev / avg balance, capped at 3.0
    -- If denominator is too small, force capped high-volatility value
    case
        when abs(avg(average_balance_in_month)) < 1000 then 3.0
        else least(
            3.0,
            coalesce(
                stddev_samp(average_balance_in_month)
                / nullif(abs(avg(average_balance_in_month)), 0),
                0
            )
        )
    end as balance_volatility_ratio,

    -- Growth compares recent 3 months vs earliest 3 months, then clamps to [-1, 3]
    greatest(
        -1.0,
        least(
            3.0,
            (
                avg(case when balance_month_rank_desc <= 3 then closing_balance end)
                - avg(case when balance_month_rank_asc <= 3 then closing_balance end)
            )
            /
            (
                abs(avg(case when balance_month_rank_asc <= 3 then closing_balance end)) + 1
            )
        )
    ) as balance_growth_rate,

    -- Number of months where account went into overdraft
    sum(case when overdraft_flag = 'Y' then 1 else 0 end) as overdraft_month_count

from source
group by customer_id

with params as (

    -- Fixed reference date for recency metrics
    select to_date('2026-08-01') as reference_date

),

txns as (

    select *
    from ML_PROJ.RAW_VALIDATED_INTERMEDIATE.int_customer_txn_base

),

profile as (

    -- Brings in effective_months for frequency denominators
    select *
    from ML_PROJ.RAW_VALIDATED_INTERMEDIATE.int_customer_profile

)

select
    t.customer_id,

    -- Average completed transactions per effective month
    count(*) / nullif(p.effective_months, 0)::float as txn_frequency_per_month,

    -- Share of months with at least one completed transaction
    count(distinct t.txn_month) / nullif(p.effective_months, 0)::float as active_months_ratio,

    -- Recency from latest transaction date to reference date
    datediff('day', max(t.transaction_date), prm.reference_date) as days_since_last_txn,

    -- Average transaction size in INR
    avg(abs(t.amount_inr)) as avg_txn_amount,

    -- Coefficient of variation - stddev / mean
    coalesce(
        stddev_samp(abs(t.amount_inr)) / nullif(avg(abs(t.amount_inr)), 0),
        0
    ) as txn_amount_cv,

    -- Share of high-value transactions
    avg(t.is_high_value) as high_value_txn_ratio,

    -- Net balance between credits and debits
    (
        sum(case when t.is_credit = 1 then t.amount_inr else 0 end)
        - sum(case when t.is_debit = 1 then t.amount_inr else 0 end)
    )
    /
    nullif(
        sum(case when t.is_credit = 1 then t.amount_inr else 0 end)
        + sum(case when t.is_debit = 1 then t.amount_inr else 0 end),
        0
    ) as net_cash_flow_ratio,

    -- Share of transactions that are debits
    avg(t.is_debit) as debit_txn_share,

    -- Share of transactions through digital channels
    avg(t.is_digital) as digital_channel_ratio

from txns t
inner join profile p
    on t.customer_id = p.customer_id
cross join params prm
group by
    t.customer_id,
    p.effective_months,
    prm.reference_date

with profile as (
 
    -- Customer spine: one row per valid customer
    select *
    from ML_PROJ.RAW_VALIDATED_INTERMEDIATE.int_customer_profile
 
),
 
balance_metrics as (
 
    select *
    from ML_PROJ.RAW_VALIDATED_INTERMEDIATE.int_customer_balance_metrics
 
),
 
txn_metrics as (
 
    select *
    from ML_PROJ.RAW_VALIDATED_INTERMEDIATE.int_customer_txn_metrics
 
),
 
product_metrics as (
 
    select *
    from ML_PROJ.RAW_VALIDATED_INTERMEDIATE.int_customer_product_metrics
 
)
 
select
    p.customer_id,
 
    -- Wealth features
    coalesce(b.avg_monthly_balance, 0) as avg_monthly_balance,
    greatest(0.0, least(3.0, coalesce(b.balance_volatility_ratio, 0))) as balance_volatility_ratio,
    greatest(-1.0, least(3.0, coalesce(b.balance_growth_rate, 0))) as balance_growth_rate,
 
    -- Engagement + transaction behavior
    coalesce(t.txn_frequency_per_month, 0) as txn_frequency_per_month,
    greatest(0.0, least(1.0, coalesce(t.active_months_ratio, 0))) as active_months_ratio,
    coalesce(t.days_since_last_txn, 730) as days_since_last_txn,
    coalesce(t.avg_txn_amount, 0) as avg_txn_amount,
    coalesce(t.txn_amount_cv, 0) as txn_amount_cv,
    greatest(0.0, least(1.0, coalesce(t.high_value_txn_ratio, 0))) as high_value_txn_ratio,
    greatest(-1.0, least(1.0, coalesce(t.net_cash_flow_ratio, 0))) as net_cash_flow_ratio,
    greatest(0.0, least(1.0, coalesce(t.debit_txn_share, 0.5))) as debit_txn_share,
 
    -- Relationship depth
    greatest(coalesce(p.account_tenure_months, 1), 1) as account_tenure_months,
    coalesce(pm.num_active_products, 0) as num_active_products,
 
    -- Balance risk / digital behavior
    coalesce(b.overdraft_month_count, 0) as overdraft_month_count,
    greatest(0.0, least(1.0, coalesce(t.digital_channel_ratio, 0))) as digital_channel_ratio
 
from profile p
left join balance_metrics b
    on p.customer_id = b.customer_id
left join txn_metrics t
    on p.customer_id = t.customer_id
left join product_metrics pm
    on p.customer_id = pm.customer_id
